lines.text: Many learners say: There is a lot of people in the park.
Better: There are a lot of people in the park.
Are! There are a lot of cars.

data.wrong: There is a lot of people in the park.
data.right: There are a lot of people in the park.

native.tip: Много людей — “there are”: “There are a lot of people in the park.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “There is a lot of people in the park”? 😅 По-русски после «много» глагол стоит в единственном числе («в парке было много людей»), поэтому тянет сказать “is.” Но people — это много человек, и нужно “are.” Правильно: “There are a lot of people in the park.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “are.” Много людей — there are. Скажи вслух: “There are a lot of … in my city.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: For many people, use “there are”: “There are a lot of people in the park.”
en.caption: Do you also say “There is a lot of people in the park”? 😅 In Russian the verb after the word for many stays the same as for one thing, so is slips in. But people means many, so you need are. Correct: “There are a lot of people in the park.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
